inspiration: CCBC12 demonstrated local-category candidates constrained by a global vocabulary and cases where decoder-choice provenance becomes a second-layer carrier. This benchmark combines those abstract reasoning lessons using original coordinate tables, original clue pairs, and a branch-path extraction.
originality_note: The title, flavor, both 6x6 lookup tables, coordinate sequences, local clue ambiguities, Greek-letter intersection, stamp paths, final extraction, and answer were newly authored for this project. No CCBC symbol stream, word list, answer, or puzzle row is reused.
